title: Chapter 1400
text:
With a flash of light, Han Xiao had already arrived at the Underworld Dimension. As soon as he entered, he saw Hella fighting Aurora.

In the pitch-black sky, two huge energy balls, one red and one gold, were closely attached to each other, like two conjoined suns. The scarlet power of the dead pressed forward, constantly squeezing the space of life energy, like a bully bullying a cowering girl.

In the center of the energy cluster floated a graceful figure. Hella's red hair danced under the surging energy, her expression indifferent and effortless.

And in the golden light cluster on the other side, Aurora's blonde hair danced wildly. She clenched her fists and raised them in front of her. Her cheeks were red, and she was using all her strength to pump out life energy, struggling to resist Hella's suppression.

"Eh, an older sister bullying a younger sister. I can't pretend that I didn't see it. Do you need help? I can help you bully back."

Han Xiao glanced at it, raised his eyebrows slightly, and shouted at Aurora.

Hella turned to glance at him, paused, and suddenly retracted the Power of the Dead.

The scarlet sun in the sky quickly shrank in the shape of a vortex until it disappeared, returning to her body.

On the other side, Aurora suddenly lost the pressure, as if two people were pushing each other, and one of them suddenly let go. The life energy that had lost its resistance spurted out involuntarily, and a golden tsunami suddenly appeared in the air.

She hurriedly restrained the energy and slowly guided it back into her body. The golden sun quickly disappeared, leaving only Aurora's figure in the air, panting rapidly, as if she was about to collapse.

Hella frowned, her sharp eyes staring at Aurora, and said in a deep voice, "Your control is still too weak. Rest for a while and continue training."

With that said, Hella turned to look at Han Xiao and explained calmly, "We're not joking.

The extreme pressure class can speed up the growth of her life energy, broaden her upper limit, and help improve her strength. This is one of the special training I designed for her. "

Han Xiao shrugged. He knew that this was training and was just joking.

At this time, Aurora also changed back to her petite figure. She flew to the front of the two people. Her face was still flushed from exerting too much force. She looked a little shy and a little embarrassed.

"The reason why I lost in the previous battle was because I wasn't strong enough. I feel that I can no longer be lazy and wait for my life energy to increase by itself. The speed is too slow, so I specially asked my sister to give me special training. Every bit of improvement counts."

"Not bad, very hardworking."

Han Xiao smiled and praised. He raised his hand and rubbed Aurora's small head. Her soft hair slid through his fingers and felt very smooth to the touch.

Aurora enjoyed it very much. She even raised her head slightly and took the initiative to get closer to Han Xiao's palm.

At this moment, Hella floated over with an expressionless face. She slapped away Han Xiao's hand and said, "Why are you looking for me? If there's nothing else, you can leave first. The special training is not over yet. Don't disturb us. "

Han Xiao rubbed the back of his hand that was red from the slap, and the mark quickly disappeared. He smiled and said, "I'm here to tell you a piece of good news. Fu Ding has already become a Beyond Grade A Super."

Hella's eyes moved, but she was not surprised. She nodded calmly.

"It's indeed a good thing. Congratulate him on my behalf. However, to him, stepping into this level is only a matter of time."

"In addition, there's another surprise for you. Fudin found the legendary Soul Return to Void and Remnant Soul End. He knows that you can devour souls to strengthen yourself, so he asked me to ask if you're interested in taking a look."

Hearing this, Hella's expression changed. Her eyes widened slightly, and she finally had some emotional reaction.

She also knew the legend of the Final Destination of Remnant Souls. The power of the dead used souls as nourishment, and she also yearned for this legendary place. However, this was just a guess. There were no sightings of the Final Destination of Remnant Souls in history. If what Black Star said was true, then Feidin should be the first to discover it.

"Of course I'm interested! When are we going? "

Almost without hesitation, Hella blurted out, instantly forgetting about Aurora's special training.

"Let's go now. Fu Ding is already waiting for you at the training base."

"Then what are we waiting for? Hurry up!"

Hella took the initiative to put on a set of King without hesitation and signaled Han Xiao to activate it with his Mechanical Force.

Han Xiao laughed, put on the King, and activated his Mechanical Force.

With a flash of lightning, the two of them disappeared without a trace.

…

More than ten minutes later, Fu Ding brought Han Xiao and Hella directly to the Soul End.

Looking at the endless Soul Remnants, Hella revealed a rare look of shock and surprise. For a moment, she forgot to speak and stared at the huge Soul Nebula vortex in a daze.

"How is this place? Is it helpful to you?" Fu Ding asked.

Hella came back to her senses and nodded decisively. There was an uncontrollable excitement in her tone.

"These Soul Remnants are very beneficial to me. My intuition tells me that this is the best place for me to train!"

"It's good that it's useful. Anyway, there's no one here. You can stay as long as you want." Fu Ding smiled.

"Thanks."

Hella patted Fu Ding's shoulder hard and habitually rubbed against him like Han Xiao did. Her eyes were fixed on the countless Soul Remnants, and there was a burning passion in her beautiful eyes.

At this moment, she made a decision without hesitation.

Before the World Tree enters the mainland, I'll be staying here. No one can pull me away!

Hella was rarely excited, but while she was happy, she vaguely felt that she had forgotten something.

At this moment, a faint voice suddenly sounded in her mind.

"Sis … what about my special training?"

Err, I knew I forgot something …

Hella's expression froze. She coughed and sent a telepathic message back.

"Ahem, things have changed. I won't be going back for a while. You can train by yourself first."

This tone was more or less like a parent who had to coax a child when they were busy with serious matters. It gave off a feeling of 'go play by yourself'.

"Humph! I'll train by myself then! "

Aurora angrily closed the telepathic message.

I've been abandoned just like that?

You promised to help me cultivate, but you ran away yourself. Stupid sister, I'm ignoring you!

Hella did not care that the mental communication was cut off. She could not wait to get out of the spaceship, and her body floated in the outer space.

Hualala!

The Power of the Dead gushed out, forming a scarlet tornado that swept up the surrounding soul dregs, crushing them and breaking them down, turning them into pure soul energy that was swallowed by the Power of the Dead to strengthen her Esper Ability.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed.

With such a fortuitous encounter, Hella is also on the fast track to leveling up. I estimate that in ten years … No, in less than ten years, a new peak Beyond Grade A Super will appear. When she reaches this level, her combat strength will be greatly enhanced. With her ability, as long as her strength grows, it won't be a problem for her to resist two or three peak Beyond Grade As of the World Tree.

He stroked his chin as he watched this scene. He nodded and had high hopes for Hella.

…

Hella and Fu Ding stayed in the Soul Terminal to cultivate. Han Xiao returned to the training base and continued to train everyone according to the original plan. He also studied the Sanctums on his own and was immersed in learning.

Fu Ding came back every few days to give the students in the training base an incentive buff.

Everyone was immersed in training every day, and their sense of time became dull. In the blink of an eye, more than half a year had passed in a frenzy of training.

The battle at the frontlines was still going on intensely, and the World Tree Army advanced unwaveringly under the harassment of the three Universal Civilizations' suicide squads.

The forums had been flooded with relevant information for half a year, and countless players were enthusiastically exchanging all kinds of combat information.

Han Xiao and the other Beyond Grade As were training at the back and had withdrawn from the frontlines, seizing the time to improve their strength in the calm before the storm. Because they were not in the eyes of the players, the Beyond Grade As did not have much to talk about in the past half a year, so they kept a low profile.

The intensity of the war meant that there were many combat missions. Many players who acted as suicide squads at the frontlines earned a lot, and batches of them reached the version limit of level 180 one after another. A portion of the extra EXP was used to level up their skills, and a portion of it flowed to Han Xiao through spending in the Black Star Corps.

Thanks to the high rewards of the suicide squad missions, the players earned EXP faster, which indirectly shortened the time it took for Han Xiao to accumulate EXP.

In less than a year, Han Xiao had roughly gathered enough EXP to level up to level 360. His efficiency was higher than expected.

After so many years, he finally had a chance to advance again. Han Xiao did not hesitate and chose an auspicious day to come to an uninhabited planet in the territory. He was prepared to invest all his EXP to level up and reach the threshold of a new Promotion.
